title: Quantum Forge: Shader Energy Coupling
description: A PrimaryIonDrive hovers above a Corset acting as an energy conduit. The user manipulates custom shader parameters on both objects—adjusting fresnel glow, displacement waves, chromatic aberration, and dissolve thresholds—to achieve a target energy resonance state. Each shader parameter on one object is coupled to parameters on the other, requiring careful multi-input balancing with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing a shader coupling workbench. Load PrimaryIonDrive.glb and position it at (0, 2.5, 0) slowly rotating. Load Corset.glb at (0, -0.5, 0) as a stationary energy conduit. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 2, 6) with OrbitControls. Add ambient light (0.3) and two colored point lights (cyan and magenta). Apply custom ShaderMaterial to both models after loading by traversing their meshes. The IonDrive shader has uniforms: uFresnelPower (0-5), uDisplacementAmp (0-0.3), uGlowColor (vec3), uDissolveThreshold (0-1), and uTime. The Corset shader has uniforms: uChromaticShift (0-0.05), uWaveFrequency (1-20), uEmissionIntensity (0-3), uNoiseScale (0-2), and uTime. Implement conservation coupling: increasing IonDrive fresnel must decrease Corset emission by half the delta, and increasing Corset wave frequency must shift IonDrive dissolve threshold proportionally. Display a GUI panel (lil-gui or custom HTML sliders) with all 8 adjustable parameters grouped by object. Show a real-time 'Resonance Score' (0-100) computed from how close all 8 values match a randomly generated target configuration displayed as ghost outlines on the sliders. Implement a full undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z) that records every slider change as a state snapshot, capping at 50 entries. Show undo/redo buttons in the UI with step count. The vertex shaders should apply sine-based displacement modulated by uniforms. Fragment shaders should combine fresnel rim lighting, procedural noise patterns, and dissolve clip effects using a noise texture generated in the shader. Add an energy beam (custom line shader with animated dash pattern) connecting the two objects whose color and intensity reflect the current resonance score. When resonance reaches 95+, trigger a celebratory particle burst using a simple point sprite system. Ensure all shader uniforms animate smoothly with lerping when changed via sliders. The task requires approximately 10-14 slider adjustments accounting for coupling effects to reach the target state.
